
```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r}
pacman::p_load(tidyverse, here, tidyverse, posterior, cmdstanr, brms, bayesplot)
```

```{r}
data <- read_csv(here("Simonsen_clean.csv"))
```

```{r}
transformed_data <- data %>% mutate(FirstRating = FirstRating - 1,
                        GroupRating = GroupRating - 1,
                        SecondRating = SecondRating - 1)
```


```{r}
transformed_data <- data %>% mutate(FirstRating = FirstRating - 1,
                        GroupRating = GroupRating - 1,
                        SecondRating = SecondRating - 1)

stan_file <- here("pba_model.stan")

model <- cmdstan_model(stan_file,
                       cpp_options = list(stan_threads = FALSE),
                       stanc_options = list("O1"))

fits <- list()

for (id in unique(transformed_data$ID)) {
  
  cat("Fitting participant", id, "\n")
  
  participant_data <- transformed_data %>% filter(ID == id)
  
  fits[[as.character(id)]] <- model$sample(
    data = list(N = nrow(participant_data), 
                first_rating = participant_data$FirstRating, 
                group_rating = participant_data$GroupRating,
                second_rating = participant_data$SecondRating,
                prior_mu = 0,
                prior_sigma = 0.5,
                total = rep(7, nrow(participant_data))),      
    seed = 123,                    
    chains = 4,                    
    parallel_chains = 4,       
    iter_warmup = 1000,            
    iter_sampling = 2000,          
    refresh = 0,                   
    max_treedepth = 10,            
    adapt_delta = 0.8              
  )
}

# Extract and save draws immediately after
draws_list <- lapply(fits, function(fit) as_draws_df(fit$draws()))
saveRDS(draws_list, here("models_fit_to_data", "pba_empirical_draws.rds"))


```
```{r}
# Check diagnostics immediately while temp files still exist
for (id in names(fits)) {
  diag <- fits[[id]]$diagnostic_summary(quiet = TRUE)
  if (any(diag$num_divergent > 0) | any(diag$num_max_treedepth > 0)) {
    cat("\n⚠️ Issues in participant:", id, "\n")
    print(diag)
  }
}
```

```{r}
wba_stan_file <- here("wba_model.stan")

wba_model <- cmdstan_model(wba_stan_file,
                           cpp_options = list(stan_threads = FALSE),
                           stanc_options = list("O1"))

wba_fits <- list()

for (id in unique(transformed_data$ID)) {

  cat("Fitting participant", id, "\n")

  participant_data <- transformed_data %>% filter(ID == id)

  wba_fits[[as.character(id)]] <- wba_model$sample(
    data = list(N = nrow(participant_data),
                first_rating = participant_data$FirstRating,
                group_rating = participant_data$GroupRating,
                second_rating = participant_data$SecondRating,
                prior_mu = 0,
                prior_sigma = 0.5,
                total = rep(7, nrow(participant_data))),
    seed = 123,
    chains = 4,
    parallel_chains = 4,
    iter_warmup = 1000,
    iter_sampling = 2000,
    refresh = 0,
    max_treedepth = 10,
    adapt_delta = 0.8
  )
}

wba_draws_list <- lapply(wba_fits, function(fit) as_draws_df(fit$draws()))
saveRDS(wba_draws_list, here("models_fit_to_data", "wba_empirical_draws.rds"))
```

```{r}
for (id in names(wba_fits)) {
  diag <- wba_fits[[id]]$diagnostic_summary(quiet = TRUE)
  if (any(diag$num_divergent > 0) | any(diag$num_max_treedepth > 0)) {
    cat("\n⚠️ Issues in participant:", id, "\n")
    print(diag)
  }
}
```
